The six selected minimized counterexamples are Scheme datums, read as data by
the existing native replay consumer. The consumer does not select a parser by
filename extension. The .scm suffix records the actual input language; it does
not turn an execution log into program acceptance. Only these source-referenced
minimal examples are curated. Complete generated publication records remain
in the owning task cache.

Every relocation preserves the original bytes. Existing native observations
are retained as history; this storage change runs no native replay and does not
upgrade a prior result to the current vendor revision.
